hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .new_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.swift$'; then swiftlint lint --quiet --path "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /(Users|Applications|System|Library)|git push.*--force.*main|git reset --hard'; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive command." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.new_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.pbxproj$'; then echo "BLOCKED: Never edit .pbxproj manually. Use Xcode." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); ACTIVE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$ACTIVE" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "--- Session complete. Did you build and run tests? If not: xcodebuild -scheme Nova -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' test ---" >&2; exit 0

echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Current git branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'). Uncommitted changes: $(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files. Swift version: $(swift --version 2>/dev/null | head -1). Swiftlint: $(which swiftlint 2>/dev/null || echo 'NOT INSTALLED - run: brew install swiftlint').\"}"
